added.author: Greeks.live
added.title: Cheap implied volatility keeps put hedges relevant
added.view: Greeks.live describes BTC implied volatility as unusually low and buyers as reluctant to pay for risk. After the weekly decline, the publisher still favours rolling monthly out-of-the-money put protection; it also notes gamma building around $80K puts.

added.author: Block Scholes
added.title: Volatility rose, but remains low by the publisher’s classification
added.view: Block Scholes reports 30-day implied volatility of 38.8% for BTC, 54.8% for ETH and 60.5% for SOL, all higher over seven days. It classifies BTC and SOL volatility as low and ETH as below average, highlighting weekend repricing ahead of oil futures reopening.

added.author: Volmex
added.title: Options become central to Bitcoin risk positioning
added.view: Volmex argues that options have become central to Bitcoin derivatives risk even though perpetuals trade more volume. Its October 15 snapshot attributes about 58.9% of combined BTC derivatives open interest to options, including US ETF options; this is its market-structure interpretation, not a directional forecast.
